title: Size and growth fixtures disagree with the save field authority
body:
## Summary
The file-size, budget and growth fixtures describe a save layout and version history the field authority does not contain.

## Description
src/lib/save-schema/fields.ts is the one authority for the 15 UARPGSaveGame fields and SCHEMA_VERSIONS declares one generation. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data.ts:107-125 still names sections and subsections that are not fields, src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-budget.ts:25-30 charts four generations, and src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/schema/BudgetAlerting.tsx:136-137 extrapolates a V3 by regression over three generations that never shipped. The compat matrix had the same defect and was emptied this round; these two lists were left because a replacement needs measured sizes, not a deletion. Fixed looks like sections keyed by SaveFieldGroup with sizes from a real save, and a growth chart that starts at the one real version.

## Flow
- Open Save > Schema > Budget Alerting
- Read a V1.1-V2.0 sparkline and a projected V3 for a project on schema v1
- Build the seeded test, then re-key the fixtures on the authority

## Expected impact
A designer stops budgeting against sections that do not exist. The projection disappears until two real generations exist, so the panel gets emptier.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - size panels describe the real schema
Before: 0/9 subsection labels match a field; 3/4 growth generations are not in SCHEMA_VERSIONS
After: predicted 9/9 mapped or removed and 0 orphan generations
Method: simulation - counted the labels by hand; the instrument and real sizes are unbuilt, and sizes need a real save to replace the numbers
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-budget.ts:25-30 GROWTH_HISTORY versions V1.0, V1.1, V1.2, V2.0 vs one entry in SCHEMA_VERSIONS (src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data.ts:83)
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/schema/BudgetAlerting.tsx:136-137 hard-coded "Projected V3.0" / "V3?"
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data.ts:107-125 nine subsection labels (ItemInstances, EquippedSlots, Stash, Level/XP, Attributes, AbilityTree, VisitedZones, Encounters, NPCStates); exact matches against the 15 UARPGSaveGame fields: 0
instrument: A test asserting every FILE_SIZE_SECTIONS/SECTION_BUDGETS label and GROWTH_HISTORY version resolves to @/lib/save-schema/fields or SCHEMA_VERSIONS, seeded red on the current fixtures.

title: Slot and integrity panels show fixtures with no reader for real saves
body:
## Summary
The Slots tab renders hand-typed saves and a hand-typed integrity verdict, and nothing can read a real save file.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts:18-25 states PASS results such as a CRC match on no input, and src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/slots/SlotManagement.tsx:74-85 had four actions per slot with no handler. This round labelled the tab as sample data and disabled the actions, which makes it honest but not useful. The context map names slot management and an integrity validator, so the capability is in scope. Fixed looks like a read-only reader of the project's save directory feeding both panels, with Load/Delete left for a separate decision because they write.

## Flow
- Build the read-only .sav lister against a fixture project
- Feed SlotManagement and IntegrityValidator from it
- Show the sample notice only when no save exists

## Expected impact
The tab reports on the developer's actual saves. Parsing UE save files can fail on custom serialization, so unreadable files must report their reason.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - integrity results describe real saves
Before: 0 of 6 validation checks and 0 of 4 slots come from a project file
After: unknown until the reader exists; target is 4 of 6 checks, excluding those needing a loaded game
Method: simulation - no fixture .sav exists in this tree, so the gate and probe rungs were not reachable this round
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-budget.ts:60-65 ENHANCED_SLOTS hand-typed
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts:18-25 VALIDATION_CHECKS, including '0xA3F7C201 == expected', hand-typed
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/slots/SlotManagement.tsx:74-85 16 action buttons, now disabled for want of a handler
src/lib/save-schema/header-audit.ts audits headers only; no reader for .sav files
instrument: A read-only API route that lists Saved/SaveGames/*.sav for a fixture UE project and returns slot metadata plus the SchemaVersion read, tested against one known .sav; then assert the panels render its rows and that the slot actions enable only when a handler exists.

title: Auto-save panel contradicts the as-5 and as-6 design
body:
## Summary
The auto-save panel disables a trigger the design requires, offers five auto-saves against a one-slot design, and forgets its slider.

## Description
src/lib/module-registry.ts:306 tells the generated code to auto-save on zone transitions, boss kills and level-ups, yet src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts:92 shows level-up off. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts:97 shows five auto-saves against the single auto slot in as-6. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/advanced/AutoSaveConfig.tsx:14 keeps the interval in useState, so the control writes nowhere. Fixed looks like the fixture matching the checklist, and the slider either persisted to something the as-5 prompt reads or shown read-only.

## Flow
- Open Save > Advanced > Auto-save
- See level-up off and 5 auto-saves
- Align the fixture, then decide whether the slider feeds as-5

## Expected impact
The panel stops arguing with the prompt that generates the code. Only fixture values and one control change.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - panel agrees with the checklist that generates the feature
Before: 2 values contradict as-5/as-6; 1 control persists nowhere
After: predicted 0 contradictions; the control decision is still open
Method: simulation - read both sides; left unbuilt because which side is authoritative for maxAutoSaves is a design call the test must encode
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts:92 levelup enabled:false, while src/lib/module-registry.ts:306 as-5 requires level-ups
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts:97 maxAutoSaves:5, while src/lib/module-registry.ts:307 as-6 specifies 1 auto slot
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/advanced/AutoSaveConfig.tsx:14 slider value is local state and is discarded on unmount
instrument: A test asserting the three as-5 triggers (zone, boss, levelup) are enabled and AUTO_SAVE_CONFIG.maxAutoSaves equals the auto-slot count, seeded red on the current fixture.

title: Advanced tab has no data source for cloud, timing or recovery
body:
## Summary
Cloud sync, the serialization profiler and the recovery tool are static mock-ups with no integration behind them, and someone has to decide whether they should exist.

## Description
No code in src touches EOS storage apart from the fixture naming it (src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts). Timings at src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts:65-79 come from no run. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/advanced/DataRecoveryTool.tsx:15,54 lets a user step through a recovery that never changes what is displayed. This round labelled the tab as sample data. Keeping these panels honest beyond the label means three separate integrations, or removing them from a design-audit tool that has no runtime to observe.

## Flow
- Operator decides per panel: integrate, keep as labelled design reference, or retire
- Integrate: headless timing for the profiler first, it is the cheapest
- Retire: remove the panel and its fixture together

## Expected impact
The operator gets a smaller tab or real data. Retiring panels removes surface the context map currently names.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - Advanced panels either report real data or are gone
Before: 0 of 4 Advanced panels read any project data
After: depends on the decision
Method: simulation - grep and code read only; whether the capability is wanted is not something an instrument can settle
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence:
grep for EOS Cloud / PlayerDataStorage over src: only src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/advanced/CloudSyncStatus.tsx:73 hard-coded "Protocol: WebSocket TLS"
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/_shared/data-panels.ts:65-79 serialization timings hand-typed
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_save/advanced/DataRecoveryTool.tsx:15,54 step state moves the highlight only; the same RECOVERY_RESULTS render at all 4 steps
instrument: An operator decision first; if kept, headless save/load timing from the UE project for the profiler and a corrupted .sav fixture for recovery.
